verdict.rationale: Avalara claims tax rates and rules for 200+ countries. It also offers a separate VAT Reporting product for preparing and submitting VAT across jurisdictions, plus cross-border duty/import tax and e-invoicing products, so global indirect tax is broadly covered. However, VAT filing sits in add-on products rather than AvaTax itself, and nexus tooling is described only generically. One community report notes that registration and filing still need separate handling. Missing for 10: explicit EU OSS/IOSS support, named UK/Canada GST/Australia GST coverage, foreign registration-threshold tracking, evidence that filing is integrated in AvaTax, and independent hands-on corroboration.
